user_authorization.statement: Count this as a Human-AI assisted gate because this is a learning project, not a live project for actual users.

review_method: Case-by-case AI semantic/policy review of all complete responses and quotes, exact approved HTML bytes/table rows, canonical metadata, and visual inspection of all nine cited PDF physical pages. User supplied learning-scope acceptance authorization, not independent case-by-case judgments. Follow-up: compared all 71 response bodies/citations/gaps against the prior reviewed release, excluding request IDs; 68 are identical and retain their judgments. Re-reviewed the three changed responses against canonical source quotes and the previously inspected original PDF pages. No new source bytes or corpus activation.
limitations: Reviewer is the same AI coding agent that implemented the fixes; this is not independent human evaluation.
Project-authored offline extractive cases; not live Groq reliability or population evaluation.
The three prior completeness findings are resolved. Existing relevance/formatting/source-ambiguity notes remain recorded per case; 100% reviewed completeness does not mean every answer is flawless.
